import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

# Load order details from both files
d1 = pd.read_excel('DanhSachHoaDonChiTiet_1.xlsx', sheet_name=0, header=2)
d2 = pd.read_excel('DanhSachHoaDonChiTiet_2.xlsx', sheet_name=0, header=2)
details = pd.concat([d1, d2], ignore_index=True)
print("Details shape:", details.shape)
print("Columns:", details.columns.tolist())

# Parse order date and status
orders = pd.read_excel('DanhSachHoaDon.xlsx', sheet_name=0, header=2)
orders['Thời gian'] = pd.to_datetime(orders['Thời gian'], dayfirst=True, errors='coerce')

# Merge
merged = details.merge(orders[['Mã hóa đơn','Thời gian','Trạng thái']], on='Mã hóa đơn', how='left')
print("Merged shape:", merged.shape)

# Status normalization
def norm_status(s):
    s = str(s).strip()
    if s in ('xong','Hoàn thành'): return 'completed'
    if s in ('hủy đơn','Đã hủy'): return 'cancelled'
    if s in ('trả lại','Hoàn trả'): return 'returned'
    if s in ('Đang giao dịch',): return 'in_progress'
    return 'other:'+s
merged['status'] = merged['Trạng thái'].apply(norm_status)
print("Status counts:", merged['status'].value_counts().to_dict())

# Week window
w = merged[(merged['Thời gian']>=pd.Timestamp('2026-08-17'))&(merged['Thời gian']<=pd.Timestamp('2026-08-19'))]
print("\nWeek window orders (all statuses):", len(w))
print("Week window by status:", w['status'].value_counts().to_dict())

# Exclude cancelled and returned
valid = w[w['status'].isin(['completed','in_progress'])]
print("Valid orders (completed+in_progress):", len(valid))

# Sum normalized quantity per product
res = valid.groupby('Mã hàng')['Số lượng quy đổi'].sum().sort_values(ascending=False)
print("\nTop 10 products by normalized quantity:")
print(res.head(10).to_string())
